metadata.description: The watchbill plugin for Claude Code.

plugins.name: watchbill
plugins.description: A role model for multi-agent work in herdr with a human in the loop: builder and steward side by side, build and run leads, pinned crew sub-types, a delegation layer for launching and closing delegates, an editor for collaborative drafting, two-party handoff with historians, paper-trail rules and the watcher contract. One seat changes the rules, another runs the work, and every relief leaves a log.
